findings.source: SpendingLimitLib.sol:272-274 do { renewalTimestamp = uint256(renewalTimestamp).getStartOfNextDay(timezoneOffset); } while (block.timestamp > renewalTimestamp); and :287-289 the monthly version
findings.issue: Both do-while loops are found and equivalent, but the daily one is rotated (the first step's checks before the loop, the step computed both in the condition and in the body, P3) and getStartOfNextDay is inlined four times per line; the monthly one is a 'while True' whose body expands the civil-date conversion (146097, 1461001...) into lines of 1000+ characters (P9).
findings.rule: Print a do-while as one loop: name the step 'r = next(r)' once in the body and test 'block.timestamp > r' at the end; name inlined function results (next day, day number) instead of repeating their expressions.

findings.issue: Same as c00525: the Initializable slot printed as a multiple of 3600 and _initialized split by its byte-wise write.
findings.rule: Never factor a slot by a time unit; take field widths from typed reads.
